## What is CircuitOS Studio?

CircuitOS Studio is a **code generation platform** that transforms visual circuit designs into
complete, production-grade embedded systems. Unlike AI code generation, CircuitOS produces
identical output every time — the same design always generates the same code.

### Platform Capabilities

| Category | Details |
|----------|---------|
| Features | 160+ across 20 categories |
| Components | 300+ definitions with verified pin assignments |
| Protocols | 30+ (WiFi, BLE, MQTT, SPI, I2C, UART, LoRa, CAN, and more) |
| Build Systems | ESP-IDF, Zephyr, Arduino, PlatformIO |
| Design Patterns | 14 GoF patterns applied automatically |
| Architecture | Enforced 4-layer (PAL → OSAL → Middleware → Application) |
| Output | Firmware + Backend API + Frontend Dashboard |
| Reproducibility | 100% deterministic — no randomness |

### How It Works

1. **Design** — Drag & drop MCU boards, sensors, actuators, and protocols on a visual canvas
2. **Configure** — Set pin assignments, communication protocols, and data flow
3. **Generate** — One click produces the entire project: firmware, backend, frontend, docs
4. **Build & Flash** — Use the generated scripts or standard toolchains

### The CircuitOS Advantage

AI models like Claude and GPT are excellent at generating code. They're fast, flexible, and
capable. But they produce **different output every time**, and they can't enforce architectural
consistency across a multi-MCU system.

CircuitOS provides what AI cannot:

- **Deterministic output** — same design always produces identical code
- **Enforced architecture** — 4-layer separation is structural, not advisory
- **Multi-MCU coordination** — DataFlow Engine syncs variables across boards automatically
- **Protocol consistency** — data contracts are generated from a single source of truth
- **Verified hardware** — pin assignments come from a tested board registry, not hallucination

**AI generates code. CircuitOS generates engineering.**
